item.title: Hobe Sound getting first Aldi grocery store at former Winn-Dixie location
item.description:

item.title: Four Arrested After Armed Robbery and Pursuit in Martin County
item.description: Four suspects were arrested following an armed robbery of a teenager and subsequent pursuit in Martin County, according to deputies.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with global artist program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is drawing local and international artists to Fort Pierce's Peacock Arts District, preserving the historic Crain Estate while offering tours and art classes.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to right knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde scare 3-2 in extra time to advance to World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi and defending World Cup champion Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 Friday in South Florida, advancing to face Egypt in Atlanta on Tuesday after the tiny island nation challenged them until the final minutes of extra time.
